patch.summary:
Thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Lemlist and Lusha share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.

Lemlist and Lusha share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits. Choose Lemlist only if your buying job matches “Multichannel cold outreach — Email from $55/user/mo yearly; Multichannel from $87/user/mo ” rather than Lusha's shape. Choose Lusha only if your buying job matches “B2B data intelligence platform for verified contact/company data, enrichment, signals, and” rather than Lemlist's shape. Workflow advantage: Lemlist leans sales-engagement; Lusha leans contact-management. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Lemlist and Lusha share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.
- Positioning: Lemlist is Multichannel cold outreach — Email from $55/user/mo yearly; Multichannel from $87/user/mo yearly; Enterprise custom; 14-day trial.; Lusha is B2B data intelligence platform for verified contact/company data, enrichment, signals, and Engage outreach sequences..
- Workflow coverage skew: Lemlist-leaning sales-engagement vs Lusha-leaning contact-management.
- Researched limits: Lemlist — Cold-outreach first — not an SI mega-database peer; Lusha — Not a full CRM pipeline/deal system — buyers still need a CRM of record for pipeline hygiene..

Limitations — Lemlist: Cold-outreach first — not an SI mega-database peer; Lead database included but secondary to multichannel sending; Lusha: Not a full CRM pipeline/deal system — buyers still need a CRM of record for pipeline hygiene.; Credit-based consumption for reveals/signals/API; unused annual credits do not roll over..

Poor-fit cases: Lemlist is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Cold-outreach first — not an SI mega-database peer · Lusha is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Not a full CRM pipeline/deal system — buyers still need a CRM of record for pipeline hygiene. · Avoid Lemlist if you actually need Lusha's motion (B2B data intelligence platform for verified contact/company data, enrichment, si)

Neither product has a completed hands-on product test on SoftwareGlimpse — this comparison is research/data-based only.
